correctness.rationale: The Rota–Baxter defect is bilinear, so checking the 16 ordered basis pairs is exhaustive for each linear map. A fresh independent bit-level enumeration tested all 16^4=65,536 maps and found exactly 80 solutions, all with R(z)=0 and rank distribution 1,25,30,24. A separate brute-force enumeration found exactly 24 unital multiplicative bijections; conjugation of the 80 solutions produced exactly 12 orbits with the stated size multiset. These are complete finite exhaustions, not samples.

evidence: Gubarev's relevant structural statements assume characteristic zero.
broader_coverage.reasoning: No inspected broader theorem covers the characteristic-two finite-field case.

final_claim: For the four-dimensional exterior algebra on two generators over F2, there are exactly 80 weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators; all kill the top-degree element, their ranks occur with multiplicities 1,25,30,24, and the 24-element algebra automorphism group has exactly 12 conjugacy orbits with sizes 1,1,3,3,6,6,6,6,6,6,12,24.
limitations: Specific to F2 and weight zero.
